notes.title: Update «Valhalla Calling»
Update from 10.25.2022
Update from 09.16.2022
Update from 07/19/2022
notes.content:
Hello Vikings. We are glad to announce a new update to our game - Valand. Below are all the changes and innovations in the game.

Was added:
— Support for French and Chinese;
— Ability to save the game;
— Ability to adjust the screen resolution.

It has been fixed:
— A bug in which the game took a long time to load;
— A bug in which the game menu was displayed incorrectly.

Thank you for your feedback, we try to eliminate all the shortcomings that you encountered as quickly as possible.

Expect further news.
Sincerely, the Valand team.
